references.text: The heavens are my throne, and the earth is the footstool for my feet
He who swears by heaven swears by God's throne and by him who sits on it
Be careful when you make a vow to the Lord your God; do not delay in fulfilling it, for the Lord your God will surely require it of you, and it would be a sin for you
When you make vows to God, do not hesitate to fulfill them, for he has no pleasure in fools. Fulfill what you promise
